button.name: action_request_approval
button.invisible: approval_state not in ('draft', 'rejected') or (is_locked and not is_lock_editor)

button.name: action_reset_approval
button.invisible: approval_state not in ('in_approval', 'rejected') or (is_locked and not is_lock_editor)

div.class: alert alert-warning d-flex align-items-center p-3 mb-0

div.div: This document is currently locked by . Only the lock owner or administrator can modify or replace it.

div.class: alert alert-danger d-flex align-items-center p-3 mb-0
alert alert-info d-flex align-items-center p-3 mb-0

div.div: This document is currently waiting for approval from:

div.class: alert alert-info d-flex align-items-center justify-content-between gap-3 mb-3

div.strong: This document inherits permissions from its folder.
div.div: Everyone with access to has the same access here. The rules below give extra people extra rights; they never take folder access away.

button.name: action_stop_inheriting_permissions
button.confirm: The folder's current permissions will be copied to this document, and later changes to the folder will no longer apply here. Continue?

div.class: alert alert-warning d-flex align-items-center justify-content-between gap-3 mb-3

div.div: Folder permissions do not apply. Only the people listed below (and the document owner) can access it.

button.name: action_restore_permission_inheritance
button.confirm: Everyone with access to the folder will get access to this document again. The rules below are kept as extra access. Continue?

div.class: alert alert-info d-flex flex-wrap align-items-center gap-2 py-2 mb-3
div.span: Already covered by an access group on this document, so they can't be added here (change their access in the Access Groups tab):

div.class: position-absolute d-flex align-items-center gap-1 px-2 py-1 rounded-pill small fw-semibold
div.style: top: 8px; right: 8px; z-index: 10; background: rgba(33, 37, 41, 0.75); color: #fff; pointer-events: none;
div.title: Unique permissions: folder access does not apply to this document

div.class: o_dms_approval_banner position-absolute start-0 end-0 px-2 py-1 text-white small d-flex align-items-center justify-content-between shadow-sm

a.name: action_approve_step
a.class: btn btn-sm btn-success px-2 py-0 d-flex align-items-center shadow-sm
a.title: Approve

a.name: action_open_reject_wizard
a.class: btn btn-sm btn-danger px-1 py-0 d-flex align-items-center shadow-sm
a.title: Reject

div.class: o_dms_lock_banner position-absolute bottom-0 start-0 end-0 px-2 py-1 text-white small d-flex align-items-center

img.style: width:20px; height:20px; object-fit: cover; cursor: pointer;

xpath.attribute: !record.is_trashed.raw_value and ((record.permission_download and record.permission_download.raw_value) or (record.permission_read and record.permission_read.raw_value))

div.t-if: !record.is_trashed.raw_value and record.permission_edit and record.permission_edit.raw_value and (!record.is_locked.raw_value or (record.is_locked.raw_value and record.is_lock_editor.raw_value))
!record.is_trashed.raw_value and (!record.is_locked.raw_value or (record.is_locked.raw_value and record.is_lock_editor.raw_value)) and record.permission_share and record.permission_share.raw_value
record.is_trashed.raw_value and record.permission_unlink and record.permission_unlink.raw_value and !record.directory_is_trashed.raw_value
record.is_trashed.raw_value and !record.is_locked.raw_value and record.permission_unlink and record.permission_unlink.raw_value

span.class: badge bg-white text-dark border px-2 py-1 shadow-sm
badge bg-primary text-white px-2 py-1 shadow-sm
